h: Unity Blessing and Holiness Culminate in the Third Meal

p: "You are One and Your Name is One,
and who is like Your people Yisrael, one nation."
will be in the World to Come,
"On that day Hashem will be One
And when there is the true unity,
then the Holy One, blessed be He, is praised
"And who is like Your people Yisrael, etc."
And Shabbos, which is a semblance of the World to Come,
as is written in the Gemara (Berachos 57b)
therefore we say "You are One, etc."
לְפִי מַה דְּאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
according to what is found in the holy Zohar (II 88a):
and it casts it to the Field of holy apples
take delight these three times, etc."
הוּא בְּכָל זְמַן ג׳ סְעוּדוֹת שַׁבָּת
is at the time of each of the three meals of Shabbos;
so why specifically in the Minchah prayer,
which corresponds to the third meal,
do we say "You are One, etc."?
(פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רטז, ב)
it is found that there are three holinesses, Yud-Beis-Kuf:
and from it comes a flow
to the letter Beis, which is blessing,
and from it is sanctified the Kuf,
which comes through the aspect of Yosef,
who is called "the flow of the wellspring of blessings,"
and of whom it is written (Bereishis 48:20):
and holiness too is the attribute of Yosef,
and holiness and blessing are one.
And the initials of these three holinesses,
equal in numerical value the three holy Names:
And they are the three holinesses of Shabbos:
which means "I am destined to be, etc.,"
and it is hidden in this world
Havayah corresponds to the holiness of Ze'ir Anpin;
corresponds to the holiness of the Field of holy apples,
which dwells among the Children of Yisrael;
and it is the entire middle line.
And the three holinesses of Shabbos
mentioned in the passage of Vayechulu:
"And He rested on the seventh day" (Bereishis 2:2)
that is, the cessation and the rest
each woman in the house of her husband."
for blessing that comes from Hashem Yisbarach
through the blessing a person has,
he can become corrupted, Heaven forbid;
but when the blessing is from Hashem Yisbarach,
then "evil does not come forth from Him" (Eichah 3:38), Heaven forbid,
And of Yaakov it is written (Bereishis 32:23):
"And he crossed the ford of Yabok";
that is, he was already perfected
שֶׁהֵם ג׳ שֵׁמוֹת הַקְּדוֹשִׁים הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
which are the three holy Names mentioned above,
Only, when he came to the other side,
the angel of Eisav wanted to hold him back,
and claimed that he was not yet perfected
וְלֹא יוּכַל לַעֲבוֹר אֶת מַעֲבַר יַבֹּק
and could not cross the ford of Yabok;
but he could not overcome him,
And the holy Zohar says (ibid., III 216b)
דְּלָא הֲוֵי לֵיהּ אֶלָּא קַב חֲרוּבִין
who had nothing but a kav of carobs:
Yet in the Gemara we do not find this
רַק גַּבֵּי רַבִּי חֲנִינָא בֶּן דּוֹסָא
but only regarding Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa;
and regarding Rabbi Elazar ben Pedas we find
דַּהֲוֵי דְּחִיקָא לֵיהּ מִלְּתָא טוּבָא וְכוּלֵּי
that he was in very straitened circumstances, etc.
מַיְיתָא זֶה גַּבֵּי רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן פְּדָת
brings this regarding Rabbi Elazar ben Pedas,
that he had a kav of carobs,
so why did it not bring the question
But regarding Rabbi Chanina it is found
"And Chanina My son is satisfied with a kav of carobs";
for he lacked nothing at all
only afterward, at his wife's request,
did he ask that they give him
of whom we find (in the Gemara there, Taanis 25a)
that he said to the Holy One, blessed be He:
עַד מָתַי אֶצְטַעֵר בְּהַאי עָלְמָא וְכוּלֵּי
"How long will I suffer in this world? etc.";
so we see that he had no peace
from the pressure and the hardship.
that a heavenly voice went forth:
that the entire world is sustained
for the sake of Chanina My son;
in that his mind was not at ease with this.
he caused that Kuf-Beis be destroyed;
since there was not the unity,
"For the vineyard of Hashem of Hosts
is the House of Yisrael, etc."
That is, in Yisrael is found
the wine of the Oral Torah,
(as is written in the Ra'aya Mehemna, Eikev,
"and he also hewed out a winepress (yekev) in it";
Only, in the pasuk the order is reversed:
while in the holy Zohar the order is
from the side of man, the meaning is unity,
as with every mitzvah we say,
לְשֵׁם יִחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
"for the sake of the unification of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah";
וְאַחַר כָּךְ בָּא הַבְּרָכָה מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
and afterward comes the blessing from Hashem Yisbarach,
alluded to in the letter Beis.
And from the side of Hashem Yisbarach the order is:
which is the wellspring of blessings;
and at once the blessing comes from Hashem Yisbarach,
and the blessing of Hashem brings holiness,
Therefore in the holy Zohar the combination is Yud-Beis-Kuf.

p: that for this reason the Sages instituted
because its essence is the wine;
as we see in the morning,
when no Kiddush text is said
but only the blessing over wine,
which is a blessing of enjoyment;
for the essence of Kiddush is the wine.
And everywhere the order mentioned is
"one sanctifies it with food and with drink,"
so they should have instituted the wine
But it is alluded to in the pasuk,
"And wine gladdens the heart of man (enosh)";
as is mentioned in the pasuk before it (Tehillim 104:14):
"and herbage for the service of man (adam)."
even in one who is at the level of enosh,
along the lines of what they expounded (Shabbos 118b):
אַשְׁרֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יַעֲשֶׂה זֹּאת (יְשַׁעְיָהוּ נו, ב)
"'Fortunate is the man who does this' (Yeshayahu 56:2)
שֶׁאֲפִילּוּ עוֹבֵד עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה כֶּאֱנוֹשׁ וְכוּלֵּי
that even one who worships idols like the generation of Enosh, etc."
"and wine to the bitter of soul";
that is, to one whose soul is bitter within him;
"The heart knows the bitterness of its soul";
like the heart among the limbs,
as is written in the holy Zohar
(פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רכא, ב)
yet it is the sustenance of all the limbs;
And about this it is written
"and wine to the bitter of soul"
"the heart knows the bitterness of its soul,"
because of the accusation of the evil inclination,
"the heart of a fool is at his left" (Koheles 10:2).
from "the heart of a fool at his left"
into "the heart of a wise man at his right."
"To make the face shine more than oil" (Tehillim 104:15):
as is written in the holy Zohar
that are called the Great Countenance
and this is what is called everywhere
וְכֵן הוּא גַּם מִגְּמָרָא (חֲגִיגָה יג, ב)
and so it is also from the Gemara (Chagigah 13b),
from the flow of the World to Come.
That is: the holiness of Shabbos,
which is that the head of Ze'ir Anpin is filled
with the dew that descends from Atika Kadisha,
and it casts it to the Field of apples,
which is the souls of Yisrael
this they merit through the wine,
לִזְכּוֹת לִקְדוּשַּׁת אֲרִיךְ אַנְפִּין וּזְעֵיר אַנְפִּין
to merit the holiness of Arich Anpin and Ze'ir Anpin.
וְלֶחֶם לְבַב אֱנוֹשׁ יִסְעָד (תְּהִלִּים קד, טו)
"and bread sustains (yis'ad) the heart of man" (Tehillim 104:15);
for there is no Kiddush except where a meal is eaten
they merit the unity on Shabbos.
"the head of Ze'ir Anpin is filled, etc.,"
And as was explained many times:
regarding what is written in the holy Zohar
how does one know when the time is?
גַּם אֵין סְעוּדַת שֶׁל כָּל אֶחָד
are not at the same hour on Shabbos.
sits down to the Shabbos meal,
then he merits that there be the unity
of "the head of Ze'ir Anpin is filled, etc.";
and this is at every meal,
at the time of the meal.
And because of this the Sages instituted
on Shabbos night and in the morning,
"And wine gladdens the heart of man"
from the bitterness of his soul,
from the accusation of the evil inclination,
which holds sway even on Shabbos;
which are the Great Countenance and the Small Countenance,
and then the unity can be,
but only at the time of the meal.
This is not so of the third meal,
who is in the aspect of rest,
"Yaakov and his sons rest on it,"
שֶׁהוּא יִחוּד קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ
which is the unity of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah,
each woman in the house of her husband";
then the rest and the unity come
at the time of the prayer.
And therefore we say in this prayer
"You are One and Your Name is One,"
for it is already a semblance of the World to Come,
when there will be the true unity,
"On that day Hashem will be One
as is explained in the Gemara (Pesachim 50a);
"and who is like Your people Yisrael, etc.,"
for the Holy One, blessed be He, is praised
אַתֶּם עֲשִׂיתוּנִי חֲטִיבָה אַחַת בָּעוֹלָם וְכוּלֵּי
"You have made Me a unique entity in the world, etc.:
and I will make you a unique entity:
'and who is like Your people Yisrael, one nation'"
Whereas we do not say this
in the other prayers of Shabbos,
only afterward, at the time of the meal,
"And wine gladdens the heart of man,
to make the face shine more than oil,"
לֹא תִּקְּנוּ חֲכָמִים קִידּוּשׁ עַל הַיַּיִן
the Sages did not institute Kiddush over wine:
since the unity has already come beforehand,
at the time of the prayer,

paragraphs.text: Source: Devarim 6:4 — “שמע ישראל יהוה אלהינו יהוה  אחד” — “Hear, O Israel! The ETERNAL is our God, the ETERNAL alone.bThe ETERNAL is our God, the ETERNAL alone Cf. Rashbam, Ibn Ezra; see Zech. 14.9. In contrast to others “The LORD our God, the LORD is one.””

paragraphs.text: Source: Divrei HaYamim I 17:21 — “ומי כעמך ישראל גוי אחד בארץ אשר הלך האלהים לפדות לו עם לשום לך שם גדלות ונראות לגרש מפני עמך אשר פדית ממצרים גוים” — “And who is like Your people Israel, a unique nation on earth, whom You, God, went and redeemed as Your people, winning renown for Yourself for great and marvelous deeds, driving out nations before …”
